# Kevin Zoss

> Partner and Head of Media and Technology at Lazy Boy Agency, an independent
> AI-first media and creator agency in Los Angeles. Plans and buys media for
> brands that show up in culture, and runs AI agent teams that build the
> agency's internal tooling.

## Who

Kevin Zoss. Los Angeles, California. Contact: kevin@lazyboyagency.com

Three jobs, one operator:

- **Media at scale.** Strategy, planning and buying across TV, digital, social,
  out-of-home and cinema. Reach and frequency math, vendor negotiation, and
  plans that survive contact with reality. Done at Lazy Boy Agency.
- **AI operations.** Five-agent AI companies with real org charts, escalation
  rules and verification gates. They build internal tools, run creator seeding
  programs, and open pull requests overnight.
- **Ventures.** A kids' physical-therapy game (Stretch Quest), a print-on-demand
  brand, a car-buying concierge, a traveling tattoo studio. Small bets built
  fast with AI teams, shipped for real.

## Lazy Boy Agency

Independent, AI-first media and creator agency based in Los Angeles.
https://lazyboyagency.com

Services: media strategy, media planning and buying (TV, connected TV, digital,
paid social, out-of-home, cinema, retail media), influencer and creator programs,
creator seeding, campaign measurement.

Selected brands Kevin has put in culture:

- **Electrolit** — multi-channel campaigns around the biggest sporting moments
  on earth: OOH, TV, cinema, social and retail, planned and bought end to end.
- **Square** — creator-led fintech launch with one of the biggest names on the
  internet, from strategy through trafficking.
- **Dr. Squatch** — creator programs and media for a challenger grooming brand.
- **Warby Parker** — influencer-first eyewear work built on taste and speed.

## Background

- Solon, Ohio. Learned how a business runs from behind a food counter, then
  built Feed Cleveland, a nonprofit routing surplus restaurant and grocer food
  to food banks.
- The Ohio State University, Columbus. Built for fan cultures on the side: a
  Cleveland Cavaliers site and a music blog aggregating emerging scenes.
  Agency side: Engauge.
- Los Angeles, agency years. Saatchi & Saatchi LA and Horizon Media LA.
  Brands included Toyota, Comedy Central, Corona and Film District.
- Venice, California. Built and sold mobile ad tech: Mobile Theory, then Aki,
  which was acquired.
- El Segundo, California. Lazy Boy Agency, plus side products like
  stretchquest.com.

## How he works

- Agent teams, not chat windows. AI runs as five-agent companies with lanes,
  worklogs, and a boss agent that reports to him.
- Verification before "done." Every agent proves its work ran, with tests,
  checks and receipts, or says "unverified."
- Loops over prompts. Recurring work becomes a scheduled loop.
- Ship small, ship real. Every venture gets a live product fast.
